name: Lawvere fixed-point theorem in topos-theoretic setting

source.question: Can the Lawvere fixed-point theorem be formalized in a topos-theoretic setting in Lean?

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Generalized Lawvere FPT to abstract evaluation structure. Proved core theorem, diagonal lemma, type-theoretic recovery, and 3 concrete instances. Sketched categorical framework (2 sorries). 0 axioms, 14 proved theorems, 294 lines.
insights: Minimal structure for Lawvere: objects, values, evaluation, point-surjectivity
cast is needed for Prop fixed-point contradictions (¬v = v)
Nat.succ_ne_self is the clean way to show successor has no fixed point
Full Mathlib CartesianClosed machinery is too heavy for one session
mathlibGaps: No Lawvere fixed-point theorem in Mathlib's category theory
